verses.text: Look, the LORD is about to empty the earth and ruin it. He will turn it upside down and scatter the people who live on it.

It will be the same for everyone: for the people and the priest, for the servant and the master, for the maid and her mistress, for the buyer and the seller, for the lender and the borrower, for the one who collects interest and the one who pays it.
The earth will be completely emptied and completely ruined, for the LORD has spoken this word.
The earth dries up and withers. The world fades away and withers. The great people of the earth grow weak.
The earth is made unclean by the people who live on it, because they have disobeyed the laws, broken the rules, and broken the everlasting covenant.
So a curse eats up the earth, and its people must pay for their guilt. So the people of the earth are burned up, and only a few are left.
The new wine dries up, and the vine withers. All who were happy now groan.
The happy sound of tambourines is silent. The noise of those who celebrate has stopped. The joyful harp is quiet.
People no longer drink wine with a song. Strong drink tastes bitter to those who drink it.
The city of chaos is broken down. Every house is shut up so no one can enter.
People cry out in the streets for wine. All joy has turned to gloom. All happiness has left the land.
The city is left in ruins, and its gate is smashed to pieces.
This is how it will be on the earth among the nations: like an olive tree after it has been beaten, like the few grapes left after the harvest.
But those who are left raise their voices and shout for joy. They shout from the west about the majesty of the LORD.
So give glory to the LORD in the east. Praise the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

From the ends of the earth we hear songs: "Glory to the Righteous One!" But I said, "I am wasting away! I am wasting away! How terrible for me!" Traitors betray. Yes, traitors betray with great treachery.
Terror, a pit, and a trap are waiting for you, people of the earth.

Whoever runs away from the sound of terror will fall into the pit. Whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in the trap. For the floodgates of the heavens are opened, and the foundations of the earth shake.
The earth is completely broken. The earth is split apart. The earth is shaken violently.
The earth staggers like a drunk person. It sways back and forth like a hut in the wind. Its sin is so heavy on it that it falls and will never rise again.
On that day the LORD will punish the powers in the heavens above and the kings on the earth below.
They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit. They will be shut up in prison, and after many days they will be punished.
Then the moon will be embarrassed and the sun will be ashamed. For the LORD of Armies will rule as king on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and he will show his glory in front of his elders.
